hero.title: Dr Dandan Zhang
hero.description:
Dr Dandan Zhang is an Assistant Professor at Imperial College London and founder of the Multi-Scale Embodied Intelligence (MSEI) Lab. Her research develops adaptive physical intelligence for dexterous manipulation across scales, connecting tactile sensing and multimodal perception, data-efficient robot learning, shared autonomy, and optical and magnetic microrobotics. Applications span robotic manipulation, robot-assisted microsurgery and scientific experimentation.

She joined Imperial in 2023 after a lectureship in Robotics at the University of Bristol (2021–2023). She received her PhD in Medical Robotics from Imperial in 2021 and her MRes in Medical Robotics and Image-Guided Intervention in 2018.

Her honours include MIT Technology Review’s Innovators Under 35 Asia Pacific 2026 recognition, first place in the 2021 UK Best PhD in Robotics competition, and the 2021 Amazon PhD Prize. A Fellow of the Higher Education Academy, she leads postgraduate Deep Learning teaching and serves as Secretary of the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society Technical Committee on Human-Centred AI for Medical Robotics.

data.title: Multimodal Perception (Sensing)
data.intro: Estimate the pose, depth and interaction state of small-scale robotic systems from microscopy images and complementary sensing.
data.description: Physics-informed image generation, sim-to-real transfer, optical microrobot perception and multi-pipette localisation.

data.title: Interactive Learning (Decision-Making)
data.intro: Combine robot learning, digital twins and human guidance to make decisions under limited observations and complex physical interactions.
data.description: Learning-based control, digital-twin simulation and adaptive shared autonomy for optical and magnetic micromanipulation.

data.title: Dexterous Manipulation (Execution)
data.intro: Develop robotic systems that navigate, reorient and manipulate delicate objects at small scales.
data.description: Optical and magnetic actuation, microsurgical teleoperation, haptic feedback and biomedical micromanipulation.

researchoverview.description: We connect sensing, decision-making and physical action to build more capable robotic systems at small scales. Our work combines physics-informed perception, digital twins, learning-based control and human–robot collaboration across optical microrobotics, magnetic manipulation and robot-assisted microsurgery. Explore our research platforms and selected publications.

opening.description: We welcome enquiries from prospective researchers interested in microrobotics, robot learning and biomedical micromanipulation. Relevant backgrounds include bioengineering, robotics, computer science, electrical engineering and related disciplines. Please see the Vacancies page for research interests and application guidance, and contact d.zhang17@imperial.ac.uk to discuss current opportunities.

data.title: PhysLadder preprint
data.summary: Our collaborative PhysLadder preprint studies physical interaction in contact-rich manipulation using a matched simulation and real-world benchmark.

data.title: IROS 2026 workshop
data.summary: Dandan co-organised the IROS 2026 workshop Physical World Models for Scaling Embodied AI in Pittsburgh.

data.title: TR35 Asia Pacific 2026
data.summary: Dandan was recognised in MIT Technology Review’s Innovators Under 35 Asia Pacific 2026.

data.title: Magnetic microrobot fabrication in Artificial Life
data.summary: Our collaborative work on rapid parallel fabrication and magnetic control of diverse microrobotic structures has been published online in Artificial Life.

data.title: ECCV 2026 workshop
data.summary: Dandan co-organised the ECCV 2026 workshop Safe World Models for Trustworthy Embodied AI in Malmö.

data.title: ICRA 2026 sim-to-real microscopy
data.summary: Our ICRA 2026 paper on physics-informed sim-to-real data augmentation for micro-object pose estimation is available with open-source code.

data.title: Mag-VLA and optical digital twin preprints
data.summary: New preprints introduce Mag-VLA for bimanual magnetic microrobot manipulation and a digital twin for virtual visuo-haptic optical microrobot teleoperation.

data.title: Biomedical microrobotics review
data.summary: Our review of embodied cross-domain intelligence in biomedical microrobots has been published in Cyborg and Bionic Systems.

data.title: Micro-dexterity and Du-FreqNet preprints
data.summary: New preprints examine micro-dexterity in biological micromanipulation and introduce Du-FreqNet for depth-dependent optical microrobot microscopy image generation.

data.title: Bi-CAST and DexterousMag preprints
data.summary: New preprints explore adaptive shared control for bimanual magnetic micromanipulation and reconfigurable electromagnetic actuation with DexterousMag.

data.title: CBS 2025 optical depth estimation
data.summary: Our CBS 2025 paper on physics-informed optical microrobot depth estimation with adaptive grids is available with code.
